;Arts and culture
*The [[Holy Name of Jesus Cathedral (Raleigh, North Carolina)|Holy Name of Jesus cathedral]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]] is dedicated. The groundbreaking took place on January 3, 2015. [https://www.wral.com/catholics-celebrate-joyful-historic-day-with-raleigh-cathedral-opening/16842265/ (WRL.com Capitol Broadcasting)]

;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**According to the [[Ministry of Defense (Afghanistan)|Defense Ministry]], between 26 and 30 [[Afghan Armed Forces|military personnel]] are dead and over 80 [[Taliban]] militants have been either killed or wounded amid intense fighting at a military base in [[Kandahar Province]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/afghanistan-attack-kandahar-taliban/28638763.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
*[[Northern Mali conflict]]
**A U.N. peacekeeping helicopter crashes during a mission in northern [[Mali]], resulting in the death of two German pilots within. [http://www.dw.com/en/german-army-helicopter-crashes-in-mali-on-un-mission/a-39847702 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[French Riviera]]
**[[Wildfire]]s prompt the evacuation of 12,000 people along the [[French Riviera]], while more than 4,000 firefighters and [[French Armed Forces]] personnel backed by 19 water-bomber planes are mobilised to extinguish the flames. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jul/26/france-wildfires-corsica-cote-d-azur-holiday (''The Guardian'')]
*[[History of Mumbai during the 21st century|History of Mumbai]]
**At least 17 people are killed in a building collapse in the [[India]]n city of [[Mumbai]] with at least 13 injured and twelve people unaccounted for. [http://www.milfordmercury.co.uk/news/national/15434567.Death_toll_in_Mumbai_building_collapse_rises_to_17/ (AP/PA via ''Milford Mercury'')]
*[[Ohio State Fair]]
**At least one person is killed and several others injured after the [[Frisbee (ride)|Fire Ball]] ride at the [[Ohio State Fair]] malfunctions while operating. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/26/us/ohio-state-fair-ride-incident/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Alaska]]
**A woman is killed aboard the ''[[Emerald Princess]]'' cruise ship as it sails to a port of call in [[Juneau, Alaska]], U.S. The passengers are detained while the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] investigates. Authorities suspect the incident is related to [[domestic violence]]. [http://www.9news.com/mobile/article/news/fbi-investigating-death-from-domestic-dispute-on-cruise-ship/459712377 (NBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Sexual orientation and gender identity in the United States military]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] [[Twitter|tweets]] that [[transgender]] Americans will not be allowed to serve "in any capacity" in the [[United States Armed Forces]]. [http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/343847-trump-calls-for-ban-on-transgender-individuals-in-military (''The Hill'')]
*[[Efforts to repeal the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act|Efforts to repeal Obamacare]]
**The [[United States Senate]] rejects "repeal only" propositions of the [[Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act]]. [[United States President]] [[Donald Trump]] lashes out at Republican Senator [[Lisa Murkowski]], who voted against the proposal. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/26/us/politics/health-care-senate-vote.html?_r=0 (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Corruption in Spain]]
**[[Spanish Prime Minister]], [[Mariano Rajoy]], testify in [[Audiencia Nacional (Spain)|Audiencia Nacional]] as a witness in the framework of the investigation into the [[Gürtel case|Gürtel corruption scandal]], of the illegal financing of his party. He is the first PM in Spain in service to attend a trial. Although he benefited from this corruption scheme, he denied any knowledge. This situation prompted a [[2017 vote of no confidence in the government of Mariano Rajoy|no-confidence motion against Rajoy's government]], which was debated on 13 June and defeated as expected on 14 June  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40728431 (BBC)]
**[[Pío García-Escudero]], the [[President of the Spanish Senate|President of the Senate]] also testify as a witness in the same investigation. [http://www.abc.es/espana/abci-garcia-escudero-citado-declarar-juicio-gurtel-201707051240_noticia.html (''ABC'')]
